profile.title: Personal profile
profile.hint: Name and age shown in the app and menu.

financial.title: Projection parameters
financial.hint: Inflation for the projection. Salary and income: history under Net worth → Cashflow. Each product return is set on the asset.
financial.returnRealHint: Today's purchasing power (recommended for long-term planning).
financial.returnNominalHint: Before inflation; useful to compare products.
financial.indexFundsRealHint: Expected annual gain from index funds, after inflation.
financial.inflationHint: Assumption for the simulation. You can use the latest INE CPI or adjust it (the ECB targets ~2% long term).
financial.ineHint: Observed inflation in Spain, not a future forecast.
financial.ineError: Could not fetch INE data. Try again.
financial.pensionHint: Expected annual return of a pension plan.
financial.savingsHint: Typical annual interest on deposits and interest-bearing accounts.
financial.realReturnBanner: You are using real returns: projection results are in today's purchasing power.
financial.realDataNotice: Inflation affects the simulation. Future salary is whatever you record in the income history (Cashflow). Product returns are set on each asset when you create or edit it.

dashboard.subtitleWithEstimates: Some fixed expenses are estimated until you complete them in Balance.

emergencyFund.have: You have {{amount}} · covers {{months}} months of expenses

balance.title: Net worth
balance.description: My accounts: where your money is (bank, funds, pensions) — update all balances the same way. Monthly savings: income minus expenses. Monthly plan (optional): habit for the projection.

setup.title: Set up your net worth
setup.subtitle: {{done}} of {{total}} steps done. Follow the order: accounts first, then savings, then allocation.

accounts.label: My accounts
accounts.hint: Enter how much you have today in each bank, fund or pension plan.

cashflow.label: Monthly savings
cashflow.hint: Paycheck and income minus fixed and leisure expenses. Usually from onboarding.

invest.label: Monthly plan
invest.hint: Optional: how much you would set aside each month per account to simulate the future.

cashflow.summaryHint: Summary of your current situation (income, expenses and savings).
cashflow.expensesSubtitle: Housing, household and leisure today. Changes update the projection.
cashflow.housingRentHint: Monthly payment only. No liability to register.
cashflow.housingMortgageHint: Payment lives here; outstanding principal is updated under My accounts at month close.
cashflow.housingRentPaymentHint: Full amount, even if you split it with others.
cashflow.housingMortgagePaymentHint: Full instalment. Your share counts toward fixed expenses.
cashflow.housingDebtMissing: You have not entered how much you still owe. Do it when entering balances.
cashflow.housingDebtNote: Total debt balance, not the monthly payment. Updated with other debts at monthly close.
cashflow.tramosSubtitle: Your situation today. If salary or paychecks change, add an entry with the month it starts.
cashflow.tramosCurrentExpensesHint: Edit expense breakdown (mortgage, household, leisure…) above; here you see the summary.
cashflow.salaryHistorySubtitle: Each entry is your paycheck from a given date. The one marked «Current» applies today; projection uses the latest match per month.
cashflow.salaryHistoryEmpty: You have not recorded your salary yet.
cashflow.expenseIncreaseHint: 0% = flat expenses; raise if you expect higher housing/leisure costs
cashflow.salaryNormalHint: Your usual paycheck amount, before spreading extra pays
cashflow.salaryFourteenNote: Extra June and December paychecks are spread across 12 months for a smooth projection. To model them as spikes, add them as a one-off annual income (coming soon).
cashflow.salaryOtherNote: With {{count}} paychecks, effective monthly income is (paycheck × {{count}}) / 12.
cashflow.annualExpensesSubtitle: Non-monthly costs you can estimate: property tax, car insurance, service, holidays, seasonal clothing…
cashflow.emergencyFundSubtitle: How many months of expenses do you want on hand? Many advisors suggest 3–6 months; 6 is a common benchmark.
cashflow.emergencyFundNoAccounts: No Bank or Cash assets yet. Add them in Net worth and enter balances to see if you meet your goal.
cashflow.emergencyFundNoBalances: You have accounts but no balances for this month. Use «Update balances» in My accounts.
cashflow.emergencyFundShortfall: You are short {{amount}} to reach your goal.
cashflow.emergencyFundLiquidHint: Liquidity = sum of Bank and Cash assets for the current month.

contributions.title: Monthly plan (optional)
contributions.subtitle: For the projection: how much you would set aside per month in each account. Does not replace Update balances.
contributions.scopeNote: What you actually have today (bank, funds, pensions…) is updated under My accounts → Update balances, the same for all. Here you only define the monthly habit you want to simulate.
contributions.allocationTitle: How your monthly savings is split
contributions.allocationLine: You save {{savings}}/month · invest {{planned}} · {{bank}} stays in the bank
contributions.allocationHint: The projection uses this split. When it happens for real, update all balances with Update balances (bank and funds alike).
contributions.allocationOverBudget: Your plan exceeds monthly savings. Lower contributions or review income and expenses.
contributions.totalMonthlyHint: Sum of active lines. Comes from monthly savings, not on top of it.
contributions.totalMonthlyEmpty: Add at least one line with an amount to see the split and projection.
contributions.weightedReturnHint: Average based on how much you contribute to each line and its return.
contributions.plansSubtitle: Each line links to one of your assets: monthly amount and how it evolves over time.
contributions.empty: No plan lines yet. Add one linked to any of your accounts.
contributions.noAccounts: Register your accounts first under My accounts (bank, funds, pensions…).
contributions.noAccountsHint: The monthly plan links to those accounts. Real balances are all updated the same way via Enter balances.
contributions.allDestinationsUsed: You already have one line per registered account.
contributions.assetModalHint: Fund, ETF or pension plan you already added under My accounts.
contributions.deleteConfirmBody: It will be removed from your monthly plan. The projection will no longer include this line.
contributions.assetMissing: No funds or pensions available. Add one under My accounts or remove another line.
contributions.assetDeleted: This asset no longer exists. Choose another.
contributions.customReturnHint: If left empty, {{default}} is used based on product type.

patrimony.title: Assets & liabilities
patrimony.subtitle: Define your accounts and update balances with the button above. Everything lives in the assets and liabilities tables.
patrimony.balancesAsOf: Balances as of {{date}} · use «Enter balances (€)» above to update
patrimony.recordBalancesWhy: How much you have in each account and how much you owe. Without amounts there is no net worth or emergency fund progress.
patrimony.recordBalancesBlocked: Add an active asset or liability below first (bank, fund, mortgage…). Then you can enter balances in €.
patrimony.stepsNeedBalances: Step 2 · You have accounts listed. Tap «Enter balances (€)» to add how much each holds.
patrimony.noAccountsYet: Add an asset or liability below before you can enter balances
patrimony.recordBalancesSubtitle: Enter each asset balance and outstanding debt for {{month}} ({{date}}). Updates net worth, dashboard and emergency fund.
patrimony.recordBalancesUpdateSubtitle: Correct amounts for {{month}} if they changed since last time.
patrimony.recordBalancesMonth: Which month are these balances for?
patrimony.recordBalancesMonthPending: Some lines in this month are still missing amounts.
patrimony.recordBalancesMonthClosed: This month already has saved balances (you can update them).
patrimony.closeUpdateSubtitle: Update amounts if they changed. Replaces that month's close.
patrimony.closeSubtitle: Enter each asset balance and outstanding debt. Saved with month-end date.
patrimony.closeEmpty: Add at least one active asset or liability before closing the month.
patrimony.closeLiabilitiesHint: Outstanding balance (stored as debt in net worth).
patrimony.assetsSubtitle: Bank, funds and pensions. Names are generated automatically. Current balance comes from Enter balances.
patrimony.tableReturnAssetHint: Annual return defined on this asset
patrimony.assetReturnHint: Prefilled from category; adjust if this product differs (e.g. another fund or savings rate).
patrimony.deleteConfirmNoHistory: It will be removed from your catalog. There are no saved balances from previous months.
patrimony.deleteConfirmWithHistory_one: It will be removed and balances from {{count}} month will be deleted. Net worth and history for those months will change.
patrimony.deleteConfirmWithHistory_other: It will be removed and balances from {{count}} months will be deleted. Net worth and history for those months will change.
patrimony.deleteConfirmDeactivateHint: To stop using it in future closes only, uncheck «Include in monthly close» when editing.
patrimony.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
patrimony.liabilitiesSubtitle: Other debt (loans, cards, family…). Mortgage is set under Income & expenses → Housing.
patrimony.liabilitiesEmpty: You have not registered other debts yet.
patrimony.liabilitiesHousingOnly: Mortgage is managed under Income & expenses. Add loans, cards or other debt here.
patrimony.name: Name
patrimony.providerHint: Pick your institution; if it is not listed, choose «Other».
patrimony.providerRequiredHint: Required unless cash or property with no institution.
patrimony.providerOptionalHint: Optional for cash or property; if empty, the type label is used.
patrimony.monthlyPaymentHint: Optional. Only affects how debt shrinks in the projection; your budget payment is in Cashflow.
patrimony.evolutionSubtitle: Observed growth from the balances you enter each month. No projection, no modelled inflation.
patrimony.evolutionEmpty: Enter balances for at least one month to see the chart.
patrimony.evolutionNeedMoreMonths: Only one month has balances. Add another month to see change and trend.
patrimony.growthEnd: Current net worth (latest month with data)
patrimony.historySubtitle: Breakdown by account and debt. Real saved amounts, last 12 months.
patrimony.historyEmpty: Enter balances for at least one month to see the detail table.
patrimony.historyScrollHint: Swipe right: saved balances appear in the latest month column (e.g. June)

projection.title: Future projection
projection.subtitle: Month-by-month simulation with compound interest. Wealth grows from net contributions plus return on what was already invested (this month's contribution does not earn return until next month).
projection.simulationNotice: Simulation from today — not your real history. Balances under My accounts do not update on their own when you edit the plan or returns. For real growth, see Evolution under My accounts.

sources.title: Projection data sources
sources.hint: Summary of what feeds the simulation. Edit each block under Net worth.
sources.investmentsHint: Monthly total from your investment plan.
sources.patrimonyFromSnapshots: Computed from your balances by asset type.
sources.patrimonyManual: Manual value (no balances this month in Assets & debts).
sources.inflationHint: Headline CPI, annual change · {{period}}. Chart on Dashboard.
sources.inflationError: Could not load INE data. Check your connection.
sources.inflationHistoryNote: Last {{count}} months published by INE (series IPC251856).
sources.inflationChartEmpty: Not enough data points for the chart yet.
sources.bucketBreakdownHint: Each bucket uses your asset returns. The % appears only here.
sources.noContributions: Set how much you invest each month under Net worth → Where I invest (funds, ETFs or pension) to fill the investment column in the table.

settings.title: Projection parameters
settings.hint: How many years to simulate. Starting net worth comes from your balances; returns come from each asset.
settings.initialPatrimonyHint: Only if you have not entered balances in € yet. Everything is assigned to the investment bucket.
settings.snapshotsPriority: The projection starts from {{amount}} based on your current balances by asset type.
settings.noPatrimonyClose: No balances for this month in Assets & debts.
settings.assetReturnsHint: Each product's return is set when you add or edit accounts under My accounts.
settings.returnModeTooltip: Real = gain after inflation (purchasing power). Nominal = gross market figure.

summary.returnGeneratedHint: What compound interest generated above your contributions.
summary.weightedReturnHint: Weighted by your current split across buckets (liquidity, investments, pensions…).
summary.breakdownTitle: What makes up your final net worth
summary.breakdownFinal: Net worth at end of period

table.scrollHint: Swipe sideways to see all columns

welcome.title: Welcome to FinanciaApp
welcome.subtitle: In a few minutes you will have a clear view of your cashflow and saving capacity. Everything is stored on this device.
welcome.name: Name
welcome.ageHint: For projections and retirement; does not affect monthly cashflow.
welcome.ageErrorTooYoung: You must be at least {{min}} years old to use the app.
welcome.ageErrorInvalid: Enter a valid whole number for your age.
welcome.formIncomplete: Check the highlighted fields before continuing.

income.title: Your income
income.intro: Enter net amounts (what lands in your account after tax and withholdings).
income.grossNetBody: Use your net pay: what hits your bank each month. Gross is on your contract and is usually higher — do not use it here.

expenses.title: Your monthly expenses
expenses.subtitle: Four blocks: housing, household, groceries and leisure. Use averages if they vary each month.
expenses.householdHint: Monthly average: power, water, gas, insurance, internet and similar (not grocery shopping).
expenses.groceriesHint: Monthly average for supermarket, pantry and meals you cook at home.
expenses.leisureHint: Monthly average: restaurants, going out, hobbies, non-essential shopping…
expenses.useDetailedView: I prefer to break down utilities, insurance, etc.
expenses.detailedIntro: Optional: enter each line yourself (utilities, insurance…). We never auto-fill amounts.
expenses.mortgageRentTotalHint: Full instalment amount, even if you split it with others. Rent only needs this. If you have a mortgage with outstanding debt, also add it under Patrimony → Liabilities.
expenses.sharePreview: We will count {{yours}}/month in your expenses (of {{total}} total).

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: Review what you entered. There is nothing else to fill in here.
summary.hint: Net worth, accounts and investments will be set up in Balance. You can change income and expenses anytime.
summary.registerPrompt: Save this progress to the cloud?
